name: waffle-chart
title: Waffle chart
description: A React waffle chart: a 10×10 grid where each cell is one percent, split by largest remainder, plus a pictogram variant with any icon. Accessible, MIT.
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
docs:
Waffle chart: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/charts/waffle

Installed in components/sheenui/charts/. Import (use your components alias):
import { WaffleChart, WaffleTable } from "@/components/sheenui/charts/waffle-chart";

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
